page.overview:
Who is Daddy Dee?

Daddy Dee is one of the houseparents, alongside Mummy Mee, of a World Government-affiliated orphanage situated on the Conomi Islands.

Daddy Dee is a tan-skinned man with brown hair and a thin, two-piece mustache. He wears a blue and white striped top hat, a blue double breasted suit, and a pair of circular glasses. He also wears a brown scarf underneath his suit.

In the anime, Daddy Dee wore a brown double breasted suit instead of a blue one. Furthermore, although he still had the blue and white striped hat, he also wore a white dress shirt with a yellow tie underneath.

In his initial anime appearance, he had a more triangular head and was given a goatee, as well as thick, spiral glasses. However, he still wore a blue and white spiral top hat.
